services.desc: 30 minutes of unparalleled Doors-off views of the Key West Fireworks on Jul 4th from the best perspective Approximately 30 Minutes About Come and celebrate July 4th and our great country's independence like you never thought possible. quotes.author: McLaughlin CDE
quotes.text: Beautiful aircraft and a great ride. Damian was friendly, made us feel comfortable, and knowledgeable of the area. Well worth the trip and a viewpoint of the area that you could never experience outside of a helicopter. Highly recommend 👍🏻

quotes.author: dreamhair hamont
quotes.text: We waren zo binnen gelopen bij de winkel, en konden dezelfde dag mee! Heerlijk dat dat nog bestaat! We hebben genoten van de 30 minuten durende trip met mooie uitleg en prachtig uitzicht

quotes.author: Calvin Gilbert
quotes.text: Flight was amazing and smooth! Damian was our pilot, he covered the island and showed some unique landmarks! Will definitely be back, maybe even for a 2nd time this week!

quotes.author: Laura PRIDGEON
quotes.text: An awesome experience. The views were stunning and Damion (our pilot) was great! Well worth the money. Would definitely fly again.

quotes.author: Jessica Rodriguez
quotes.text: Are helicopter ride was an enjoyable experience from our pilot to our ride. We were even to see sharks from high in the sky.

quotes.author: Catherine Reining
quotes.text: The entire experience was amazing & a life long wish. Flying over the water was my favorite if I have to pick 1 thing.
